Package io.webagent4j.verification

package io.webagent4j.verification
Deterministic, side-effect-free, pollable conditions over current page state - used both as action postconditions (IPreparedAction#expect(...)) and standalone.

Verifications is the primary entry point: static factories for URL, title, element-state, element-data, and semantic-diff conditions, plus allOf/ anyOf/not composition. IVerification is the extension point applications implement for a custom condition; a condition only ever checks whether it holds at the current polled instant - it never re-triggers the action that preceded it. VerificationEngine and VerificationPoller poll a condition (or a list of them) against a WaitEngine-driven budget, optionally the exact same shared budget an action's other pipeline stages already draw from.

This package owns read-only conditions and polling only; it cannot depend on Playwright or another concrete browser backend. See docs/verification.md for the full list of built-in conditions and the precise scope of what a satisfied verification actually guarantees.
